_comment: Operator control switches. Source of truth for on/off across the system; env vars (DUMMY_MAIN_ENABLED, DUMMY_CRYPTO_ENABLED, DUMMY_SPORTS_ENABLED, DUMMY_SPORTS_<LEAGUE>_ENABLED, DUMMY_LLM_<BACKEND>_ENABLED = 0/1) override per key. Edit via scripts/dummy_switches.py. Fail-safe: a missing/broken file reads as all-on (except the CLI LLM backends, which default off). main=false idles the whole brain.
